title: Test CAse
summary: Field assessment confirmed compliance failure and high ecological impact risk requiring immediate remediation.
recommendations: Dispatch response unit, seal perimeter, and file environmental impact statement.
notes: Logged via offline autonomous fallback protocol.
raw: An unauthorized commercial gathering took place inside the public park premises, involving the installation of a high-decibel public address system and outdoor amplifiers. Sound levels monitored at the boundary wall reached a peak of 78 dB, severely exceeding the statutory 45 dB nighttime limit mandated for residential/silence zones under the Noise Pollution Rules. Despite verbal requests from local residents, the operators refused to lower the volume or dismantle the sound stage after the 22:00 IST legal cutoff.
